notes.title: Summer 2025 Session Update
notes.notes: [p]A few small improvements made to Light Rush during our summer session at the studio:[/p][list][*][p]Settings are now in the right style, whether from the pause menu or main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Settings now contain a sound slider that adjusts and saves the level of [b]most[/b] of the sound. We're going to say most. A few sound tags may have escaped. If you catch them, let us know which ones?[/p][/*][*][p]Controllers usually work in the UI. If not, using the mouse for a moment will reactivate them. If you spot a specific place that they break, we need to know that too. [/p][/*][*][p]Music is now present for all map stages! ːsteamhappyː[/p][/*][*][p]Keep an eye out for updates on our other Steam projects: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3510390/Chumps_Chained/"]Chumps Chained[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495480/Derby/"]Derby,[/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484980/Game_Design_at_WVU_Arcade/"]GDIM Arcade[/url]![/p][/*][*][p]Follow us on the web for info on our latest events: [url="https://www.monrivergames.com/"]https://www.monrivergames.com/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45545091/5b38dba9bd3c7651f83e0df2e16d993cf122f2e2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]
